nvao-melee._note: One- and two-handed melee and fists, vanilla, DLC, GRA and TTW's Fallout 3 weapons: draws and holsters only (the split); its swings stay out

_split: . Other authors' sets supply only draw (Equip), holster (Unequip), reloads (incl. tactical and looped starts) and jam clears
_soundStandIns: Sounds a set's keys play but it doesn't carry (some are typos in the keys: G3MagRelesae, ServiceRifleFoley..): the nearest of his own sounds.
_keep: Draw (Equip), holster (Unequip), reloads, jam clears - and everything for thrown (1gt) and placed (1md) explosives: a throw has no recoil, sway or aim of ours to keep.
